en: {fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}If I don't concentrate, I'll probably hurt myself, so I'm trying to do it properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}My self-defense teacher at the castle. He said it was for my own good, in case of emergency.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It was way more fun than etiquette, so I worked really hard at it. Maybe it was just more playtime to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}What's gotten into you?! Thanking me all of a sudden. Do you have a fever or something?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're so brave and fierce.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}How dare you say that to a delicate maiden! Would you cut that out?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4780}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}It's a pain, so I hardly ever do. Besides, I throw them in battle and they get lost.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}If I don't concentrate, I'll probably hurt myself, so I'm trying to do it properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I was already at the dojo before I could remember anythin'. Feels like playin' just turned into trainin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It turned into real trainin' once I seriously wanted to get strong.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But deep down, maybe I'm always lookin' for ways to turn playin' into trainin' too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Most interesting? Enterin' martial arts tournaments, for sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}They haven't been holdin' many lately, so I'm bummed.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Places with crowds, huh... Not really, but I like fighting arenas and stuff.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, I'm takin' it easy. This kinda thing's nice once in a while!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Except for special trainin', I didn't get many chances to be alone...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Well, it's relaxin', so I like it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah, thanks!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you train even on your days off?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Hahaha. When I decide to rest, I rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sometimes you gotta switch gears and take a good long rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Places with crowds, huh... Not really, but I like fighting arenas and stuff.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Except for special trainin', I didn't get many chances to be alone...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Well, it's relaxin', so I like it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}My weapon's my own body, and the weapons I actually use ain't nothin' special.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't really worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Train every single day! Wantin' to get good fast is proof you're a slacker.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Of course! If you don't concentrate, you'll get hurt when you least expect it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Besides, focus is a must in a fight, so trainin' your focus matters too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}My old man, of course! He's the only martial artist I respect.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}He's been workin' me to the bone since I was a kid. But someday I'm gonna surpass him for sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What're you sayin'? I'm just doin' what I oughta.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}If you wanna thank me, do it after it's all over. Okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Keep up the good work.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, you bet! I'm gonna be the strongest martial artist there is!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Keep up the good work.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, you bet! I'm gonna be the strongest martial artist there is!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hehehe... I've forgotten something that long ago. You ask amusing things, my dear angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Interesting? Not much, really.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've grown tired of cards... and I can't spend all my time drinking. What about you, my dear angel? Know anything interesting?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really.{n}{wait}{clear}Though when I'm dancing, I do want lots of people watching.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes, I'm taking it easy. You should rest a little too. Everyone needs to space out now and then.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, being alone calms me. I don't have to think about anything unnecessary.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get a good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Hehe... Thank you. You should rest a little too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What makes a drink a good one?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Let me see... I don't care for sweet ones, so I like them dry, without a lingering aftertaste.{n}{wait}{clear}But you don't have to force yourself to match me, my dear angel. Don't trouble yourself on my account.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really.{n}{wait}{clear}Though when I'm dancing, I do want lots of people watching.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I've never given it much thought. But neglecting it could cost me my life, so I'm careful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Keeping at it, even just a little, I suppose. Above all, don't rush. And don't get arrogant.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Yes, more or less... But do you realize what you're doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}That was a long, long time ago. I've forgotten...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}My, what's the matter, my dear angel? So formal all of a sudden. Hehehe...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry for relying on you so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}What's this? At a time like this?{n}{wait}{clear}I don't mind being relied on, so don't worry about it. Just think things through when you make a request.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you play when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Let me see... I picked flowers in the meadows, and went to the woods to gather nuts...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh my? That's not so different from now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you find most interesting right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Interesting? This is my first time on such a long journey, so whatever I do is fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like places where lots of people gather?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Places where people gather? I'm not very good with them.{n}{wait}{clear}I've hardly ever been anywhere with lots of people, so the crowds seem to make me dizzy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you relaxing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Yes, thank you, Angel. I'm taking it nice and easy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like being alone?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I get a little lonely sometimes, so I can't say I like it... But I'll do my best for you, Angel!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thank you. Please rest once in a while too, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you take the herd far out to graze?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}On sunny days, I sometimes go as far as a hill a little way off.{n}{wait}{clear}I think the cows like it better too, with a nice view and plenty of room.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When do you look after your arms and armor?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Um, I just wipe off the dirt. I'm not used to handling weapons...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a secret to getting better?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Um... I think there's nothing for it but training every day.{n}{wait}{clear}I have to try much, much harder too, don't I, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you concentrate?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Yes... But I'm not good at combat practice, so sometimes I can't really concentrate.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Who taught you to handle weapons?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Um, no one taught me, really... I just tried my best with whatever I thought I could use...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh? Oh, Angel... I, um, I've still got so far to go...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}When you say something like that so suddenly, it makes me feel all tingly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You just have to do your best, in your own way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Y-yes! Thank you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
